name: scoped
description: Scoped - coding agent workers (Claude Code, Copilot ACP, VS Code Web) + API + CLI

scripts.docker:up:infra: worktree-env && scripts/dev-compose.sh up -d redis azurite mongodb
scripts.docker:dev: worktree-env && COMPOSE_EXPERIMENTAL_WATCH_POLL=1 scripts/dev-compose.sh -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build --watch
scripts.docker:dev:claude-code: worktree-env && GIT_BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD) COMPOSE_EXPERIMENTAL_WATCH_POLL=1 scripts/dev-compose.sh --env-file .env --env-file apps/workers/coder-acp-claude-code/versions.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile claude-code --profile report --profile portal up --build --watch
scripts.docker:dev:copilot: worktree-env && GIT_BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD) COMPOSE_EXPERIMENTAL_WATCH_POLL=1 scripts/dev-compose.sh --env-file .env --env-file apps/workers/coder-acp-copilot/versions.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile copilot --profile report --profile post-processor --profile portal up --build --watch
scripts.docker:dev:portal: worktree-env && GIT_BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD) COMPOSE_EXPERIMENTAL_WATCH_POLL=1 scripts/dev-compose.sh -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile portal up --build --watch
scripts.docker:dev:all: worktree-env && GIT_BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD) COMPOSE_EXPERIMENTAL_WATCH_POLL=1 scripts/dev-compose.sh --env-file .env --env-file apps/workers/coder-acp-copilot/versions.env --env-file apps/workers/coder-acp-claude-code/versions.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile claude-code --profile copilot --profile report --profile post-processor --profile portal up --build --watch
scripts.docker:dev:build: worktree-env && GIT_BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD) scripts/dev-compose.sh --env-file .env --env-file apps/workers/coder-acp-copilot/versions.env --env-file apps/workers/coder-acp-claude-code/versions.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile claude-code --profile copilot --profile report --profile portal build
scripts.docker:down: worktree-env && scripts/dev-compose.sh --env-file .env --env-file apps/workers/coder-acp-copilot/versions.env --env-file apps/workers/coder-acp-claude-code/versions.env --profile claude-code --profile copilot --profile report --profile portal down --volumes
scripts.docker:build: worktree-env && scripts/dev-compose.sh --env-file .env --env-file apps/workers/coder-acp-copilot/versions.env --env-file apps/workers/coder-acp-claude-code/versions.env --profile claude-code --profile copilot --profile report build
scripts.test:copilot:concurrent: concurrently -n req1,req2 -c blue,green "pnpm cli submit -m 'Request 1: Say hello' -w coder-acp-copilot -u $API_ENDPOINT" "pnpm cli submit -m 'Request 2: Say goodbye' -w coder-acp-copilot -u $API_ENDPOINT"
scripts.test:all-coders: concurrently -n copilot,claude -c blue,magenta "pnpm cli submit -m 'Hello from Copilot test' -w coder-acp-copilot -u $API_ENDPOINT" "pnpm cli submit -m 'Hello from Claude test' -w coder-acp-claude-code -u $API_ENDPOINT"
